title: nefw-world-heavyweight
label: Tommy McKnight

won.source: The broadcast's own result block: "WINNER AND NEW NEFW WORLD HEAVYWEIGHT CHAMPION TOMMY MCKNIGHT".

how: pinned Blade in the main event
note: Held through a drawn rematch at State of Shock, both men counted out.

title: nefw-world-heavyweight
label: Blade

won.source: The broadcast's own result block: "WINNER AND NEW NEFW WORLD HEAVYWEIGHT CHAMPION BLADE", with the commentary calling it his fourth reign.

how: pinned Tommy McKnight with Darkness Falls in a no-disqualification match
note: The commentary counts this as Blade's fourth reign with the championship.

title: nefw-north-american
label: Scourge

won.source: The broadcast's own result block: "Winner & New NA Champion: Scourge".

note: Kept the belt against the Senator on the Nemesis of 22 February 2002.

title: nefw-television
label: White Lightning Chris Rogers

won.source: The broadcast's own result block: "Winner: New NEFW TV Champion: White Lightning Chris Rogers".

how: escaped the cage after the Flash
note: Kept the belt on a double count-out against Rude Dude three days later.

title: nefw-tag-team
label: Absolute Insanity

won.source: The broadcast's own result block: "WINNERS...(And NEW Tag Team Champions) ABSOLUTE INSANITY, RAY LAYDEN AND JONATHAN LAYDEN".

how: pinned Lightning Kid in a Back Alley Brawl after New Era interference
note: Lost the belts to Deckard and Rasco Raines in a triple threat match at Body Count.

title: nefw-tag-team
label: Deckard and Rasco Raines

won.source: The broadcast's own result block: "THE WINNERS AND NEW NEFW TAG TEAM CHAMPIONS OF THE WORLD, ...DECKARD AND RASCO RAINES".

how: Deckard pinned Jon Layden after Rasco Raines eliminated Malligant and Method LeBonheur
note: The federation's own September handbook records the Tag Team Titles suspended indefinitely for lack of roster depth; no further title match is served on these broadcasts.

title: nefw-hardcore
label: Ripper

won.source: The broadcast's own result block: "WINNER AND NEW HARDCORE CHAMPION RIPPER".

how: pinned Robert Washington under the 24/7 rule
note: Held the title only a moment before Jon MacDonald cashed in the 24/7 rule on the same show.

title: nefw-hardcore
label: Jon MacDonald

won.source: The broadcast's own result block: "WINNER AND NEW HARDCORE CHAMPION JON MACDONALD".

how: pinned Ripper immediately under the 24/7 rule
note: MacDonald then rescinded the 24/7 rule as champion.

title: nefw-north-american
label: Vigilante

won.source: The broadcast's own result block: "Winner and NEW North American Champion: Vigilante".

how: covered the fallen Drayven after newcomers Dante and a masked man struck him down in a Harlem Street Fight
note: Raptor earned the next challenge for the title by winning the same night's Scaffold Battle Royal.

title: nefw-unified-intercontinental
label: Tommy McKnight

won.source: The broadcast's own result block: "th' WINNER!! AN' NEW UNIFIED INTER-CONT-I-NENTAL CHAMP-I-ON... THE SUICIDE BLONDE, TOMMY MCKNIGHT!!".

how: a second Suicide Bomb after Corona's Beer Blast staggered the champion, in a two-out-of-three-falls match
note: Kept the belt against the Crimson Christian on Impact two and a half weeks later, with Senton's interference turning the match.
